```lean
induction n with d hd,
  case lg_target 0 => sorry, -- This case is not reachable due to hn
  case lg_target (d+1) =>
    have h1 : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := hd,
    have h2 : 2 * (2 ^ d) = 2 ^ (d + 1) := by rw [pow_add, mul_two],
    rw [h2] at h1,
    exact le_trans h1 (le_add_right 1 (2 ^ d))
```
